metaTitle: Restaurant Marketing in Doral, FL | Button Up Media
metaDescription: Bilingual restaurant marketing in Doral, FL: Spanish-first social video, Google, websites and ads from the Miami team behind The Fatty Crab's 21M+ views.
answer: Button Up Media is a bilingual Miami agency that helps Doral restaurants get found and chosen, with Spanish-first social content, Google search, websites and ads.
heroSub: Our organic social for The Fatty Crab on NW 87th Ave earned 21M+ views and 110K+ followers. Here is what we would do for your restaurant.

market.h2: Doral eats in Spanish, at lunch and with the whole family
paragraphsHtml: Doral is a young, fast-growing city just west of Miami International Airport, often nicknamed Doralzuela for its large Venezuelan community. You also hear Colombian, Cuban and Peruvian Spanish on every block. Many of your guests read reviews, watch videos and search Google in Spanish first.

The day splits into two crowds. On weekdays, the offices and warehouses near the airport send out a lunch rush that wants good food, fast. Evenings and weekends belong to families in the newer neighborhoods around Downtown Doral and CityPlace Doral, who pick a place the whole table will like.
New neighbors keep arriving, and they are actively looking for their spots. The restaurant that shows up well on Google and Instagram, in the language they search in, is the one they try first.

facts.label: Language
facts.value: Spanish first, with plenty of English

needs.h2: What actually fills tables in Doral

items.title: Spanish written for Doral, not translated
items.body: Captions, Google posts and review replies should sound the way your guests talk, in warm Caribbean and South American Spanish, with English alongside for the office crowd.

items.title: Win the lunch search
items.body: When someone near the airport searches for lunch at 11:45, your Google profile needs current hours, a clear lunch menu, good photos and one-tap directions or ordering.

items.title: Give families a reason to pick you
items.body: Families decide from photos and reviews. Show real portions, the room on a busy night and your staff, and answer every review in the language it was written in.

items.title: Treat delivery as a second dining room
items.body: Delivery apps are part of the decision here. Pack-out shots, a clear order link and posts timed to dinner can move orders without paid ads, as The Fatty Crab's Uber Eats Reel showed.

proof.h2: Proof from right here in Doral

items.body: A Cajun seafood boil spot on NW 87th Ave. We built content pillars around food, experience, people and culture, quick video templates and a posting schedule tuned to their audience, at 6.5% engagement.

items.result: Uber Eats orders, no ad budget
items.body: One Reel built on "order tonight" urgency, with pack-out shots and an "Order on Uber Eats" call to action, posted at peak delivery hours. It drove orders on organic reach alone.

plan.h2: What we would do for a Doral restaurant

items.title: Bilingual content that shows the food
items.bodyHtml: Our crew shoots at your restaurant, then we post Reels and TikToks in Spanish and English and answer the comments. It is the same social media and content service behind The Fatty Crab.

items.title: Show up for "near me" in both languages
items.bodyHtml: We set up and manage your Google Business Profile so you appear for searches like "comida venezolana Doral" and "lunch near me." Our restaurant SEO and Google Business Profile service covers the details.

items.title: A fast, bilingual site that takes orders
items.bodyHtml: Most Doral guests find you on a phone. We build custom, mobile-first restaurant websites in English and Spanish, with your menu, ordering and reservations one tap away.

items.title: Ads aimed at the right blocks and hours
items.bodyHtml: When you need a slow Tuesday filled or a new menu launched, we run Google and Meta ads to nearby offices and neighborhoods, with every call and order tracked.

shoots.body: We come to you. Our own in-house crew shoots photo and video at your restaurant, and one shoot typically gives us 4 to 6 weeks of content. We plan the shot list with you and work around your rush, for example the gap between lunch and dinner, so service keeps moving. On camera, your team can speak Spanish, English or both.

pricing.bodyHtml: Most restaurants invest $1,500 to $5,000 per month for a coordinated program across social, search and ads. Website builds are one-time: $1,500 for a Website Build or $2,000 for an Integrated Website Build. Ad management has no long-term contract. On a free call we will tell you which pieces you need first.

faqs.q: Do you work with restaurants in Doral?
faqs.a: Yes. We are based in Miami, and our work for The Fatty Crab on NW 87th Ave is one of our best-known case studies. We work with restaurants, bars and cafes across Doral, from Downtown Doral to the office districts near the airport.

faqs.q: Do you create content in Spanish?
faqs.a: Yes. Our team is bilingual, so captions, ads, Google posts and review replies can run in Spanish, English or both, written the way Doral actually talks.
We plan the shoot with you so it fits around service. Busy moments can make great footage, but signature dishes are easier to shoot when the kitchen is calm.

faqs.q: Can you help with delivery orders, not just dine-in?
faqs.a: Yes. For The Fatty Crab, one organic Reel with pack-out shots and an "Order on Uber Eats" call to action, posted at peak delivery hours, drove orders with no paid budget.

faqs.q: How much does restaurant marketing cost in Doral?
faqs.a: Most restaurants invest $1,500 to $5,000 per month for a coordinated program. Website builds are a one-time $1,500 or $2,000. We will give you a real number for your restaurant on a free call.

cta.h2: Let's talk about your Doral restaurant
cta.body: Tell us what you want more of (weekday lunches, weekend families or delivery orders) and we will show you where we would start. Free, in English or Spanish, no pressure.
